name: plan-picker
title: Plan Picker
description: Plan cards in a tray: the pick lifts with a popping check, over a button with streaming chevrons.

perf.budget: Card lifts and checks are UI-thread springs on change; the button chevrons loop on the UI thread while it is on screen.

measurements.notes: Animating at rest: the button chevrons stream in a loop while it is on screen.

a11y.reducedMotion: Cards and checks change without springing and the chevrons hold still at fixed brightness.
a11y.screenReader: A radio group; each plan is a radio reading its name, trial, monthly price and billing. The button is named by its label.
a11y.touchTarget: Plan cards are over 80 pt tall; the button is 64 pt.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add plan-picker`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
